theme_central: Dispelling doubts about three realities: Tawhid, the afterlife and prophethood — from man's creation out of clay to the hidden reward of the night worshippers.

branches.title: Authenticity of the Qur'an, creation
branches.resume: Undeniable divine origin of the Qur'an, shaping of man from clay, denial of the resurrection refuted.

children.t: Divine origin of the Qur'an, no doubt possible
Creation of the heavens and earth, shaping of man, breathing in of the spirit

branches.title: Day of Judgment, hidden reward
branches.resume: Scene of the guilty before their Lord, the night worshippers and their hidden reward.

children.t: Scene of the guilty before their Lord, divine verdict
The night worshippers, leaving their beds, hidden reward
Separation of believers/wrongdoers, lesser punishment to bring back before the greater one

branches.title: Mission of the Prophet, closing
branches.resume: The Book given to Musa as a reference, destroyed generations as an example, final patience.

children.t: The Book given to Musa as a reference, leaders established among the patient
Destroyed generations as an example, the Prophet's patience requested
